verdict.rationale: The only documented opt-out lets users stop their Materials from being used for AI model training. That is a related control, not an opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking. Nothing in the evidence documents a way to disable analytics, telemetry, or usage tracking, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: If you do not want us to use your Materials to train AI models, you can opt out by visiting app.instinct.com/settings.
